integrity: The proof is symbolic and unbounded. The bundled computation checks exact rational inequalities and performs a finite regression scan only; no finite enumeration is used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem determines the exact minimum prime-support size for failure of \(\varphi(\psi(n))\le n\), but does not classify counterexamples with \(\omega(n)\ge6\) or give distributional estimates.
title: A sharp five-prime-support barrier for \(\varphi(\psi(n))\le n\)
